root_causes.description: Extreme memory usage spike (z=+10.52) far exceeding all other services, accompanied by elevated CPU usage (z=+1.11). This is the most anomalous signal in the incident window and likely causes downstream propagation of errors and latency.

Significant memory usage spike (z=+2.69) above baseline, the second highest memory anomaly in the window. May contribute to degraded performance or propagation of issues through the ad service dependency path.

P99 latency spike (z=+0.90) is the most notable latency anomaly in the window, with observed window mean of 3.979ms vs baseline 2.978±1.1ms. Cart is an entry point service and latency here could propagate to frontend users.

remediation_steps: Investigate fraud-detection container for memory leak or unbounded resource consumption - consider adding memory limits/restarts policy
Review ad service memory allocation and check for similar leak patterns; consider resource limit adjustments
Profile cart service latency spikes - check for downstream dependency bottlenecks or increased request volume
